newsitem.title: USA: HCC Insurance to buy Dallas insurance company.
newsitem.headline: HCC Insurance to buy Dallas insurance company.

text.p: HCC Insurance Holdings Inc. said Monday it agreed in principle to buy all outstanding shares of Aviation & Marine Insurance Group Inc. in a stock deal worth about $15.5 million.
Under the agreement, HCC will offer 625,000 HCC common shares for the Dallas-based private company.
HCC's stock edged down 12.5 cents to $24.75 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading.
HCC, a speciality insurer based in Houston, said the deal should boost earnings per share in 1997 and 1998, and close by the end of February.
HCC said Aviation & Marine's principal subsidiary, Signal Aviation Underwriters in Dallas, should have about $66 million in gross written premium volume for 1997.
